name: io.github.Servosity/connectwise-control-mcp
title: ConnectWise Control MCP
description: Manage ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect) remote support and access sessions from one CLI or agent.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your ScreenConnect instance base URL, e.g. https://company.screenconnect.com (per-instance).

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your ConnectWise Control instance user name (HTTP Basic auth).

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your ConnectWise Control instance password (HTTP Basic auth).

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectWise Control requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (32 characters or more). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.
